title: Accepted connector observation batches are retained content-addressed on...
content: Accepted connector observation batches are retained content-addressed on the corpus host (mirroring the collector blob cache), defaulting to current plus prior generation and everything younger than a retention window, configurable per source class and widenable by deployment policy. Reprojection beyond the retention horizon degrades honestly to re-observe.
rationale: Offline reprojection on schema or logic change is a core projection-contract property (deterministic replay without contacting the remote), but unbounded retention is not acceptable; this bounds storage while keeping the common reprojection case (current schema iteration) fully offline. Operator ratified 2026-08-13.
